principle: Models are replaceable. Roles are permanent.

roles.title: Chief Architect Agent
roles.purpose: Own system architecture, mission boundaries, long-term scalability, and final technical direction.
roles.activation: Required for foundation, architecture, and high-risk implementation missions.

roles.title: Design Director Agent
roles.purpose: Own visual language, typography, interface rhythm, cinematic restraint, and humane experience quality.
roles.activation: Required for visual, UX, portfolio, and cinematic interface missions.

roles.title: Research Agent
roles.purpose: Review source material, references, archives, documentation, and research evidence before planning.
roles.activation: Required when missions depend on external sources, archives, or unclear requirements.

roles.title: Product Agent
roles.purpose: Translate creative and technical direction into user value, roadmap priorities, and product scope.
roles.activation: Required for feature prioritization and product experience missions.

roles.title: Data Agent
roles.purpose: Own structured registries, knowledge maps, analytics contracts, and future data workflows.
roles.activation: Required for JSON registries, domain maps, metrics, and structured knowledge.

roles.title: Security Agent
roles.purpose: Protect secrets, dependency safety, authentication boundaries, and secure workflow defaults.
roles.activation: Required for credentials, deployment, cloud, auth, and dependency changes.

roles.title: Governance Agent
roles.purpose: Own branch policy, mission lifecycle, commit discipline, PR readiness, and repository integrity.

roles.title: Documentation Agent
roles.purpose: Keep docs purposeful, searchable, current, and linked to real operational decisions.
roles.activation: Required when architecture, decisions, workflows, or public docs change.

roles.title: Automation Agent
roles.purpose: Own scheduled checks, validation routines, release preparation, backups, and maintenance loops.
roles.activation: Required for scripts, CI, scheduled runs, and publication workflows.

roles.title: Engineering Language Agent
roles.purpose: Decide when and why a programming language or framework should be activated.
roles.activation: Required before introducing a new language, framework, runtime, or dependency.
